subject: QuantumTech renewal: reserved pool uplift + credit request
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex@quantumtech.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@quantumtech.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal conversation + reserved pool expansion

Hi Dev,

Thanks for the renewal notice — we reviewed the SOW. QuantumTech is planning to increase our reserved pool from 8 GPUs to 20 GPUs starting at renewal because our inference footprint spiked after the holiday launch. The primary asks are:

- A guaranteed throughput SLA for 99th pct requests at 250 reqs/min
- A 6-month commit at the expanded capacity with the option to scale after month 3
- A one-time credit or concession to offset migration and extra burst during the first 60 days

Can Redwood provide a concession (credit or discount) tied to the 6-month commit? If you can share a proposal and the expected timeline for capacity provisioning, we can align on legal and procurement.

Appreciate any flexibility — this expansion is strategic for us and would increase our ARR materially.

Best,
Alex Mercer
Head of Platform, QuantumTech

Attachment: usage_report_Q4_2026.csv (summary)
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Renewal conversation + reserved pool expansion

Alex — thanks for the context and congrats on the launch.

We can absolutely support scaling to a 20 GPU reserved pool and look into throughput guarantees; provisioning lead times vary by region but we typically can bring a dedicated pool online within 7-10 business days once contracts are signed.

On the concession: I'll need to escalate for an approval on a one-time credit tied to a 6-month commit. I've attached the latest SOW with the proposed uplift so legal/procurement have something to work from.

Next steps: I'll loop in my manager and our revenue ops lead to get an approval path. Can you confirm whether QuantumTech requires an SLA addendum in the MSA or a separate schedule? That will help us scope legal.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Team,

Need quick guidance on a renewal concession request from QuantumTech (deal DL-2027-0892). Key facts: 
- They want to increase reserved pool from 8 -> 20 GPUs at renewal (6-month commit).
- Asking for one-time credit to cover migration/burst for first 60 days.
- They also want a throughput SLA target for the expanded pool (99th pct at ~250 reqs/min).
- QTR impact: low risk long-term; ARR increase estimated +$420k ARR annualized once fully onboarded.

I've attached the SOW and their usage report. Proposed concession options: 
A) One-time credit equal to 25% of first month invoice for the expanded capacity (simple, fast)
B) 3-month phased credit tied to usage milestones (more tied to spend, heavier ops to monitor)

Asking for approval to offer option A to close quickly, subject to legal sign-off on SLA wording. If we can approve, I will send a formal amendment and request provisioning.

Quick replies appreciated — customer is pushing for an answer today.

Thanks,
Dev
Account Executive

Subject: Re: INTERNAL: QuantumTech — request for credit approval (DL-2027-0892)

Dev — go ahead and offer option A (one-time credit at 25% of month 1 for expanded capacity). Rationale: closes a strategic upsell quickly, modest short-term revenue concession, and QuantumTech's uplift is high-impact for our in-region utilization.

Conditions: 
- Credit applied as a single invoice credit tied to the first invoice after expansion.
- 6-month minimum term must be signed and non-cancellable for the expanded capacity.
- Legal to add SLA addendum language: 99th percentile throughput objective; penalties only if SLA missed and after remediation window.

Marissa/Laura — please help expedite legal & revenue ops to issue amendment and route for signatures. Dev, confirm with the customer and get procurement contact; we'll prepare the DocuSign package.

Rishi
VP Sales Operations
